args.result:
Rewrote src/result.ts with full type safety, verified clean under `tsc --strict`:

- **`Result<T, E>`** — discriminated union: `{ success: true; value: T } | { success: false; error: E }`. Narrowing on `success` gives safe access to `value` or `error`.
- **`ok<T>(value: T): Result<T, never>`** and **`err<E>(error: E): Result<never, E>`** — constructors typed so `never` lets them widen to any `Result<T, E>` when composed.
- **`map<T, U, E>(result: Result<T, E>, fn: (value: T) => U): Result<U, E>`** — the failure branch returns the narrowed `Err<E>` directly (no cast needed thanks to discriminant narrowing); `fn` receives a properly narrowed `T`.
- **`flatMap<T, U, E>(result: Result<T, E>, fn: (value: T) => Result<U, E>): Result<U, E>`** — chains fallible operations while preserving the error type.

All `any` parameters/returns were removed; thrown errors in `map`/`flatMap` are captured as `Err` values.
